title.native: 葬送のフリーレン 第2期

description:
Following the First-Class Mage Exam, the trio—elven mage Frieren, warrior Stark, and first-class mage Fern—gains access to the dangerous Northern Plateau. As the party presses onward toward Aureole, formidable adversaries force Stark to confront his insecurities, solidifying his resolve and his role as the party's frontliner. Meanwhile, Fern continues to cherish the gifts she has been blessed with throughout her life, each a reminder of those she holds dear.

Frieren—still honoring her vow to understand humanity—revisits memories of her journey with the Hero's party and her fleeting encounter with a legendary figure. As she reflects on the passage of time, the elven mage quietly questions whether she has truly changed, yet in the small, almost subtle choices that she makes, there are signs that she might have become more human than she realizes.

(Source: MAL Rewrite)

node.description:
Frieren is the protagonist of _Sousou no Frieren_ and [Fern](https://anilist.co/character/183965)'s master. She was the Mage of the Hero Party and traveled alongside Hero [Himmel](https://anilist.co/character/184311/Himmel), Warrior [Eisen](https://anilist.co/character/184312/Eisen), and Priest [Heiter](https://anilist.co/character/184310/Heiter) in a 10-year journey to defeat the Demon King. 

She was a magic prodigy at a young age, with an impressive quantity of mana, which caught the interest of [Flamme](https://anilist.co/character/219733/Flamme), a human wizard who taught her everything there is to know about magic and mana control until she passed away. Frieren persists in collecting magic knowledge no matter how trivial it may be.

Fern is the young mage apprentice of [Frieren](https://anilist.co/character/176754/Frieren) and accompanies her as a member of her party. She is an orphaned war refugee originally from the Southern Lands, later adopted by  [Heiter](https://anilist.co/character/184310/Heiter) and placed under Frieren's care.

Stark is a warrior who fights alongside [Frieren](https://anilist.co/character/176754/Frieren) and [Fern](https://anilist.co/character/183965/Fern). After his village was attacked by demons, he fled and became [Eisen](https://anilist.co/character/184312/Eisen)'s apprentice. At Eisen's instruction, he joined Frieren's party as their vanguard.

Hero and Leader of the party that defeated the Demon King, and a self-proclaimed handsome narcissist. He cares about his friends and can't help but help those in need. He had a great influence on [Frieren](https://anilist.co/character/176754/Frieren), with whom he had adventures for 10 years.
Dwarf warrior who was a part of the Hero's party, later became a mentor to [Stark](https://anilist.co/character/184313/Stark).
A priest who is a part of the Hero's party. He later took care of [Fern](https://anilist.co/character/183965/Fern) until [Frieren](https://anilist.co/character/176754/Frieren) arrived.
She lived a millennium before the story and was [Frieren](https://anilist.co/character/176754/Frieren)'s teacher.

Sein is a Priest from a small village in the Alt Woods. After [Frieren](https://anilist.co/character/176754/Frieren) spotted his talent, he joined her group for a period of time with the goal of reuniting with his childhood friend Gorilla.

An elven mage who is said to possess knowledge about nearly every magic that exists. She was Flamme's master. She founded the Continental Magic Association around 20 years before Himmel's death. First-class mages get the privilege of meeting her and can ask for any magic they desire.

Denken is an imperial mage of the second-class. In his youth he belonged to an army but became an imperial mage after winning a power struggle. Often calm and calculating, however he still has a fire burning within despite his old age. He saw [Frieren](https://anilist.co/character/176754/Frieren) as his motivation to become a mage. ~!Becomes a first-class mage after the examination.!~
A mage that can use restraint and mental manipulation magic. Good at detecting mana and can use simple recovery magic.

Second-class mage and the leader of the eighth party during the first stage of the First Class Mage Exam. He is the captain of the Northern Magic Corps and is thus a very experienced mage. Specializes in magic that restrains the opponent when their body is in full-view.

Macht is a demon and a member of the Seven Sages of Destruction that directly serve the Demon King.

He wishes to understand human emotions and find a solution for humans and demons to coexist.
He strives for this goal by utilizing inhumane methods.

alternative: Dantoudai no Aura (断頭台のアウラ)

node.description:
Aura is one of the Seven Sages of Destruction directly serving the Demon King. 

~!She later was killed by [Frieren](https://anilist.co/character/176754/Frieren) after being commanded to kill herself using her own Auserlese.!~
First-class mage who was a proctor for the first examination.
The Hero of the South is a Hero who fought on the front lines against the demons for mankind before Himmel met Frieren. He was said to be mankind's strongest.
Stark's older brother, referred to as the strongest warrior in the village.
Second-class mage in the Eighth Party, alongside Wirbel and Scharf, in the First Class Mage Exam. Fern feels that she is the strongest within both the Fourth and Eighth parties.
Edel is a second-class mage in the Seventeenth Party, alongside Blei and Dunst, of the First Class Mage Exam. She specializes in Hypnosis Magic.
Scharf is a third-class mage and member of the eighth party along with Wirbel and Ehre for the First Class Mage Examination.
An Elf acquaintance of Frieren and the creator of the inscription that names Boshaft as the finest spirit in the world.

An old friend of Denken. First Class Mage and Serie's apprentice. Rarely acts directly, preferring stealth.
~!Helped in the extraction and transfer of information necessary for the liberation of Denken's hometown.!~

alternative: Kamiwaza no Revolte (神技のレヴォルテ)

node.description: Revolte, also known as Divine Revolte, is a demon general. Revolte wields four swords made of magic.

alternative: Zenchi no Schlacht (全知のシュラハト)

node.description: Schlacht, also known as the Omniscient Schlacht, is a demon who was said to be the Demon King's confidant.

alternative: Kiseki no Grausam (奇跡のグラオザーム)

node.description: Grausam, also known as the Grausam the Miraculous, was one of the Seven Sages of Destruction that served the Demon King.
The president of the Norm Company in the Northern Plateau.
Böse, also known as the Immortal Böse, was one of the Seven Sages of Destruction.
Dach Hakushaku's butler.
Graf Dach's great-grandfather.
